annotations.text:
The chip is a sentence: field · operator · value.

"Platform is any of 2 selected" survives being read at a glance in a way "x, tiktok" does not — and the operator is what makes multi-select legible at all.

Today's bar has five single-value menus. This replaces them with one grammar that Library, Creators and any future page can all speak.

Sources leads with health, not a connect button.

The split bar is the thing no competitor shows: captured live vs backfilled. A backfilled item's saved-at is an import stamp, and pretending otherwise is how a library quietly lies about its own history.

Stale and sign-in states say what to do, on the card, not in a toast that has already gone.

Three of the ten states the popup can now be in, drawn from durable run and outbox records.

Note what is missing: any wording that could outlive the fact behind it. A row cannot say "saved" while its outbox still holds something, and the details line is redacted before it reaches the screen.
